alert_pattern: Incident: AWS US (us-1) - Track Job / AWS SLED (us-gov-1) - Track Job (monitoring_tool: Runscope)
diagnosis_steps: Check the failing assertion in the Runscope test result (observed: "Status '500' was not a number equal to 200")
Run/await the next test execution - transient 5xx often passes on the subsequent run
Run the equivalent manual test (submit a job / API call) to confirm the platform actually works
resolution_steps: Most occurrences: subsequent automated test passes AND manual test passes -> document 'Manual test passed', resolved
If the manual test also fails: treat as a real API incident - pivot to the ApiSuccessRate playbook (5xx log investigation)
gotchas: Single-run Runscope failures are noisy; two consecutive failures or a failing manual test is the real signal
The same alert on multiple envs simultaneously suggests a shared dependency, not coincidence
escalation: None for transient; API on-call for confirmed failures
